## Ctx.renderDocumentAuto() method

Sends or edits a document message using the page template, auto-selecting between [Ctx.renderDocument()](./gramstax.ctx.renderdocument.md) and [Ctx.renderEditMedia()](./gramstax.ctx.rendereditmedia.md) based on `!!this.callbackQuery`<!-- -->.

Template block: `<g-media>` (read via `renderAutoMedia`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderDocumentAuto(keyboard?: IInBoKb | null, data?: IData | null, AGBaseId?: string | null, options1?: IOptReplyDocument | null, options2?: IOptEditMedia2 | null, fallbackEdit?: IOptFallbackEdit): Promise<unknown>;
```

Promise&lt;unknown&gt;

The sent or edited message object.

## Remarks

Callback-query updates edit in place while plain messages reply.

## Example


```typescript
async handleCallbackQueryData() {
  await this.renderDocumentAuto()
}
```
